1339-4616-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4616-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2558-6351-8095--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6351-8095--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

728-874-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
728-874-2866-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2852-7841-8089.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

3591-4591-8089.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

6798-7388--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

4050-5544-6634.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-7692.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Repeat.

3967-4419--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

891-1258-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-4772-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4772-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2034-2820-4679-4742.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

3525-4028-5268.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

104-2557-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2557-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1894-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

874-4195-4574-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4195-4574-5243.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

141-997-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-997-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2292-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

880-4677-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4677-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

273-3156-4763-5004.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2921-3821-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2921-3821-5140.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

7-586-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4304-4875-5641.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen
4304-4875-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Conspiracy, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Conspiracy, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

678-4050-5676.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reef Worm, adding {U}.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Enduring Renewal triggers.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating a 3/3 Fish creature token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Reef Worm from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fish, adding {1}.
When the Fish dies, it triggers, creating a 6/6 Whale creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Whale, adding {1}.
When the Whale dies, it triggers, creating a 9/9 Kraken creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Kraken, adding {1}.
Cast Reef Worm by paying {3}{U}.
Repeat.

2921-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-5663--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

186-2816-4315.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle and Careful Cultivation attached to the same creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
186-2816-4315.description:
Activate the creature with Careful Cultivation and Umbral Mantle attached by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the creature by paying {2} and untapping it, causing it to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2067-2542-3353.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
2067-2542-3353.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Touch of Darkness by paying {B}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Touch of Darkness.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

1636-2422.notablePrerequisites: Lich Lord of Unx does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2422.description:
Pay {U}{B} and tap Lich Lord of Unx to create a 1/1 Zombie.
The Zombie enters untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
